metadata.capacity_source: User-provided Carnival Corporation fleet report (2026-05-31) via existing cruise JSON
metadata.itinerary_source: Previously supplied partial November sailing schedule, November 18-30
data_notes: Dock Report covers November 1-30 but not necessarily every vessel movement at the port.
Dock report records are not equivalent to unique voyage departures or passenger embarkations.
Passenger capacity is missing for ships not covered by provided fleet reference.
No capacity is invented or inferred from tonnage or vessel length.
Terminal AAA is retained as printed in the Dock Report, not silently remapped to AA.
Voyage options are attached only for exact matching ship and departure date.
